name: The Cousin She Shouldn't Love
overview: On the eve of her glamorous society wedding, Isabella Gallo discovers her fiancé Matthew is cheating — with her own stepsister. Humiliated and betrayed, she flees the chaos of her family’s expectations and finds unexpected refuge with Luca Moretti, Matthew’s enigmatic cousin and heir to the powerful Moretti family empire. As Isabella navigates heartbreak, revenge, and the relentless gaze of public scandal, sparks ignite between her and Luca — a man torn between loyalty to his family and his growing affection for her. What begins as an act of defiance soon turns into a deep emotional connection, but their past secrets threaten to destroy it all.
